intro: Each permission turns on a part of the app. Each one is only used by the features you turn on.

accessibility.title: Read the screen
accessibility.description: The Copilot reads offers from the apps

howTo.title: How to turn on reading
howTo.step1: 1. Find Offer Copilot and turn on the first option. Leave the shortcut off.
howTo.step2: 2. Android warns about full control. It's the standard warning for this permission: the app reads the screen and doesn't tap anything for you.
howTo.step3: 3. If the option is blocked, open the app details, tap the three dots, and allow restricted settings.

overlay.title: Display over apps
overlay.description: Shows the card on top of the offer

location.title: Location
location.description_km: Tracks your shift's kilometers by GPS
location.description_mi: Tracks your shift's miles by GPS

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.missing: Without notifications you won't see the shift in progress or your car reminders.

battery.title: No battery saving
battery.description: Keeps Android from stopping the Copilot
